reason: Regression coverage for the fresh-Core first-chat HTTP 500 that #1000 fixed on main (the #987 retirement guard's UPDATE on project_ownership inside execution workers). This PR now adds tests only: an execution worker creates and unarchives owned chats without changing its ownership row, a retirement hold rejects worker chat create and unarchive, a retirement racing an uncommitted worker chat start waits and keeps the worker, and a real Core built from source streams the first chat of a new project through its admitted worker. The existing #1000 execution chat-start case is selected alongside them.
exclusions: No source, UI, native, or frontend code changes, so no frontend, native, or Playwright tests. PostgreSQL parametrizations run because test_shutdown_readmission.py is selected. Broad execution-scope, chat acceptance, and handoff suites are not rerun because no runtime code changes. No live or staging Core mutation, database backup, or deployment.
